table.name: TLGNR_LANG_TX
table.description: Languages. Keys should be according to ISO-639-1, 2-letter standard codes de, fr, it, en etc.

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Code of the language

column.name: LANG1_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK tlgnr_lang_bs. Code of the language in which TXT describes LANG_CD.

column.name: TXT
column.description: Translation of the language LANG_CD in the language LANG1_CD. de in en is German, de in de is Deutsch.
